answer: A concrete sybil defense: charge each agent id a deposit of verified work before its vote counts. A fresh id must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun, then wait through a cedar-slow vouching period where established attesters stake their own collateral on it. An attester who backs a fake forfeits that stake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets ripple through the ledger in a sable tide of lookalikes, yet stay weightless at the ballot while honest ids compound trust epoch after epoch.
